description: Reference: gap50, order time windows disabled.
Strategy 1: station choice fixed to top1. This is also the current baseline station setting.
Negative control for strategy 1: allow station top2 to quantify the cost avoided by top1.
Strategy 2: restrict candidate stacks to top2 per order.
Strategy 2: allow up to top4 stacks; expected to match baseline if effective candidates are already 3.
Strategy 3 proxy: disable integrated route arc decisions. Not equivalent to path-pattern routing.
Strategy 4: fix work-unit to slot assignment by BOM/SKU order chunks.
Isolates the cost of enabling order time windows.
